card.name: The 4 in pioglitazone 45 mg
card.fires_on: The digit 4 (or the bracket just before it) that begins the number 45 in pioglitazone dose statements, as in a maximum of 45 mg. It appears in pioglitazone dose tables and maximum-dose sentences.

modes.label: Digit 4 of 45 mg
modes.description: The first digit of 45 right before mg, when giving the pioglitazone maximum dose.
modes.example: • If there is inadequate glycemic control, the dose can be increased in 15 mg increments up to a maximum of <<4>>5 mg once daily.

modes.label: Bracket before 45
modes.description: The opening bracket just before 45 mg after pioglitazone in an interaction table.
modes.example: for the following: Oral Antidiabetic Agents Metformin (1000 mg) 20 mg ↔ ↔ Pioglitazone<< (>>45 mg) 50 mg

card.plain: It fires on the start of the number 45 when it is the top pioglitazone dose.
